description: This file defines the ClassSourcer class, which extends ASM's ClassVisitor to generate Java source code from Java class bytecode, including handling class signatures, annotations, fields, and methods.

classes.name: ClassSourcer
classes.description: A class visitor that generates Java source code from class bytecode, handling class declaration, annotations, fields, methods, and skipping inner and outer class details.

methods.name: visit
methods.description: Handles class declaration, writes package, class signature, super class, interfaces, and opens class body.

methods.name: visitAnnotation
methods.description: Handles class annotations, writes annotation declaration.

methods.name: visitField
methods.description: Handles field declarations, skips synthetic fields.

methods.name: visitMethod
methods.description: Handles method declarations, returns a MethodSourcer to generate method stub.
